fact: Connecting Africa reports that Starlink received a licence in Burundi in May 2024.
Connecting Africa reports that Starlink launched services in Burundi in September 2024; a commentator says it is too expensive for many citizens, with equipment above $500.
MyBroadband's table of Starlink status in African countries lists Burundi as 'Available' on 17 July 2026 (article date, no other date given).
TechMag lists Burundi among the African markets where Starlink is 'Active Now' as of mid-2026 (article date, no other date given).
Le360 lists Burundi among 29 African countries where Starlink had been granted a licence as of May 2026 (article date, no other date given); no regulator or licence date is named for Burundi.
The article says optic-fibre ISPs and satellite providers (Starlink, NT Global) drive Burundi's internet market.
